title: The signed finite sum adds the fresh term on the right
statement: `Int.sumRange f (n+1) = Int.sumRange f n + f n`, the recursive equation of the signed finite sum, and the statement that FIXES the convention. Closes by `Eq.refl`. The exclusive bound and the right-hand accumulation match `Nat.sumRange` and `Int.prodRange` exactly. WHAT NO EVALUATION CAN CHECK: `Int.add` is commutative, so a definition folding the fresh term onto the LEFT computes the identical value at every argument and satisfies every other lemma in this family; only this stated type distinguishes the two, and a character-for-character type pin is what enforces it. `Kernel::axiom_footprint` is EMPTY. Admitted by the trusted gate on the first attempt.

formal.statement: theorem Int.sumRange_succ : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Int)) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Int (Int.sumRange x0 (AxNat.succ x1)) (Int.add (Int.sumRange x0 x1) (x0 x1))))
